beats.summary: Michael serves alcohol at the office Christmas party despite Toby's objection.

evidence.snippet: Michael: This is Christmas spirit, as in spirits, booze.
Toby: We're really not supposed to serve alcohol.

beats.summary: Roy and Darryl discuss their fantasy football teams and trades.

evidence.snippet: Roy: I think after I lost Culpepper and T.O it was over, man.
Darryl: I had to. I needed defense.

beats.summary: Pam receives a teapot gift from Jim with a hidden yearbook picture inside.

evidence.snippet: Pam: I traded with Dwight. Just, I figured, you know, you went to a lot of trouble and it means a lot.
Pam (opens teapot): Oh my god! The yearbook picture!

beats.summary: Todd Packer arrives at the party and interacts with Michael and Toby.

evidence.snippet: Todd Packer (grabbing Michael around the neck): Merry Christmas, asswipe!
Michael: Oh, let's fix you up. Who wants to fix up … Toby. Toby's gonna fix you up.
